References

How to cite

If you use the DRAFT forecasting tool or the released data products, please cite it together with the paper describing the pipeline and the forecasts:

  • S. Raghunathan, J. Meyers, C. Trendafilova & B. Wallisch, DRAFT: Dark Radiation Anisotropy Flowdown Team Forecasting Tool, https://github.com/sriniraghunathan/DRAFT (2026).

  • C. Trendafilova, S. Raghunathan, B. Wallisch, J. Meyers et al. (CMB-S4 Collaboration), Sensitivity of Next-Generation CMB Surveys to Neutrinos and Other Light Relics, arXiv:2608.XXXXX.

Depending on your use of DRAFT, also consider citing the following:

  • A. Zonca et al. (2021a) and A. Zonca et al. (2021b) for the galactic-foreground simulations,

  • E. George et al. (2015) and C. Reichardt et al. (2021) for the extragalactic-foreground templates,

  • S. Raghunathan & Y. Omori (2023) for the internal linear combination,

  • D. Blas et al. (2011), D. Green et al. (2017), S. Hotinli et al. (2021a) and S. Hotinli et al. (2022) when using CLASS_delens for the delensed power spectra,

  • S. Hotinli et al. (2021b) and S. Hotinli et al. (2022) when employing FisherLens for the Fisher-matrix calculations.

Component separation

Sky masking

Galactic foregrounds

  • B. Thorne, J. Dunkley, D. Alonso & S. Naess, The Python Sky Model: Software for Simulating the Galactic Microwave Sky, Mon. Not. Roy. Astron. Soc. 469 (2017) 2821, arXiv:1608.02841 [astro-ph.CO].

  • Y. Akrami et al. (Planck Collaboration), Planck 2018 Results. XI. Polarized Dust Foregrounds, Astron. Astrophys. 641 (2020) A11, arXiv:1801.04945 [astro-ph.GA].

  • A. Zonca et al. (CMB-S4 Collaboration), Map-Based Simulations for CMB-S4 (Design Tool Run), https://github.com/CMB-S4/s4mapbasedsims/tree/main/202102_design_tool_run (2021a).

  • A. Zonca, B. Thorne, N. Krachmalnicoff & J. Borrill, The Python Sky Model 3 Software, J. Open Source Softw. 6 (2021) 3783, arXiv:2108.01444 [astro-ph.IM].

  • A. Zonca et al., Documentation of the PySM Simulations for the Simons Observatory, https://so-pysm-models.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html (2022).

Extragalactic foregrounds

  • L. Shaw, D. Nagai, S. Bhattacharya & E. Lau, Impact of Cluster Physics on the Sunyaev-Zel’dovich Power Spectrum, Astrophys. J. 725 (2010) 1452, arXiv:1006.1945 [astro-ph.CO].

  • E. George et al., A Measurement of Secondary Cosmic Microwave Background Anisotropies from the 2500 deg² SPT-SZ Survey, Astrophys. J. 799 (2015) 177, arXiv:1408.3161 [astro-ph.CO].

  • C. Reichardt et al. (SPT Collaboration), An Improved Measurement of the Secondary Cosmic Microwave Background Anisotropies from the SPT-SZ + SPTpol Surveys, Astrophys. J. 908 (2021) 199, arXiv:2002.06197 [astro-ph.CO].

Internal linear combination

  • J.-F. Cardoso, M. Le Jeune, J. Delabrouille, M. Betoule & G. Patanchon, Component Separation with Flexible Models – Application to Multi-Channel Astrophysical Observations, IEEE J. Sel. Top. Signal Process. 2 (2008) 735.

  • M. Remazeilles, J. Delabrouille & J.-F. Cardoso, CMB and SZ Effect Separation with Constrained Internal Linear Combinations, Mon. Not. Roy. Astron. Soc. 410 (2011) 2481, arXiv:1006.5599 [astro-ph.CO].

Forecasting

The delensing and Fisher-matrix stages are performed by the two companion codes CLASS_delens and FisherLens, which are driven from within this repository by get_fisher_forecasts module, delensing module and fisher module.

Delensing

  • D. Blas, J. Lesgourgues & T. Tram, The Cosmic Linear Anisotropy Solving System (CLASS) II: Approximation Schemes, JCAP 07 (2011) 034, arXiv:1104.2933 [astro-ph.CO].

  • D. Green, J. Meyers & A. van Engelen, CMB Delensing beyond the B Modes, JCAP 12 (2017) 005, arXiv:1609.08143 [astro-ph.CO].

  • S. Hotinli, J. Meyers, C. Trendafilova, D. Green & A. van Engelen, CLASS_delens: Delensing Module for the CLASS Code, https://github.com/selimhotinli/class_delens (2021a).

  • S. Hotinli, J. Meyers, C. Trendafilova, D. Green & A. van Engelen, The Benefits of CMB Delensing, JCAP 04 (2022) 020, arXiv:2111.15036 [astro-ph.CO].

Fisher forecasts

  • S. Hotinli, J. Meyers, C. Trendafilova, D. Green & A. van Engelen, The Benefits of CMB Delensing, JCAP 04 (2022) 020, arXiv:2111.15036 [astro-ph.CO].

  • S. Hotinli, J. Meyers, C. Trendafilova, D. Green & A. van Engelen, FisherLens: Fisher Forecasting Code for CLASS_delens, https://github.com/ctrendafilova/FisherLens (2021b).

  • J. Ryan, B. Stevenson, C. Trendafilova & J. Meyers, Beyond Fisher Forecasting for Cosmology, Phys. Rev. D 107 (2023) 103506, arXiv:2211.06534 [astro-ph.CO].

Foreground biases

  • D. Huterer & M. Takada, Calibrating the Non-Linear Matter Power Spectrum: Requirements for Future Weak Lensing Surveys, Astropart. Phys. 23 (2005) 369, arXiv:astro-ph/0412142.

  • M. Loverde, L. Hui & E. Gaztanaga, Magnification-Temperature Correlation: The Dark Side of ISW Measurements, Phys. Rev. D 75 (2007) 043519, arXiv:astro-ph/0611539.

  • A. Amara & A. Réfrégier, Systematic Bias in Cosmic Shear: Beyond the Fisher Matrix, Mon. Not. Roy. Astron. Soc. 391 (2008) 228, arXiv:0710.5171 [astro-ph].

  • S. Hotinli, J. Meyers, C. Trendafilova, D. Green & A. van Engelen, FisherLens: Fisher Forecasting Code for CLASS_delens, https://github.com/ctrendafilova/FisherLens (2021b).
